attributes.action: Have a vote of no confidence on PM Andy Burnham and call a general election
attributes.background: Our country has consistently been failed by our own current government, nothing was stuck to in the manifesto and well since Andy Burnham has come in it’s got worse. Call a general election and let the public have there vote, we didn’t elect him as PM

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
